_comment: Tier-2 Layer-C: FEBio numerical-correctness gate — the first executed numeric assertion this backend has ever had. 2x2x2 hex8 patch test on [0,1]^3: u = (F-I).X prescribed on all 26 boundary nodes via the `prescribed deformation` BC, the single interior node left free. Asserts (a) the free node lands on the exact linear field to 1e-12, (b) the Cauchy stress in all 8 elements equals the closed-form St.Venant-Kirchhoff pushforward sigma = F(lam tr(E) I + 2 mu E)F^T/J to 1e-8, (c) the stress is uniform across the patch. Assertion (b) pins the constitutive law: FEBio's `isotropic elastic` is SVK on the Green-Lagrange strain, NOT small-strain linear elasticity — a fact that had been asserted in the catalog but never executed. Verified 2026-08-03 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF, skyline): interior-node error 1.39e-17, max stress error 3.46e-11, element spread 1.00e-13. Skips cleanly (still emitting febio_patch_test=) when no febio4 binary is installed.
